name: Ados Fragment
summary: At Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands, Ados Fragment lies among three lost pieces of the Goaz Stone. Together, the four shards make an ancient relic carved with Titan inscriptions.

sections.title: A Piece of the Goaz Stone
sections.body: The Ados Fragment is one of four pieces Prospector Whelgar needs to restore the Goaz Stone at Whelgar's Excavation. Before raptors overran the dig site, Whelgar began translating the main tablet and found its inscriptions broke off at crucial moments. The four pieces, named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru, were lost across the ruins in ancient containers and dirt mounds, among prowling beasts.

sections.title: The Titan Script
sections.body: Prospector Whelgar can read the full Titan script carved into the Goaz Stone once he joins Ados Fragment with the other three pieces. The completed text speaks of a grand divine plan and a doomed prophecy, then declares, “Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.” It reveals that the Titans imprisoned primordial entities beneath Azeroth in ages past.

faq.answer: Ados Fragment is one broken piece of the ancient Goaz Stone, found at Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands. Its carved script comes from the world-shaping Titans.
The fragment lies across Whelgar's Excavation, east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. It is usually inside ancient relics or loose soil patches, with territorial raptors nearby.
Ados Fragment's inscription is incomplete on its own. Prospector Whelgar needs the Modr, Golm, and Neru fragments to continue translating the tablet.
Prospector Whelgar seeks Ados Fragment to finish translating the Goaz Stone. He is an Explorer's League dwarf overseeing the ruined excavation site.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorer's League seeks Titan relics like Ados Fragment to uncover the origins of your people and their ancient makers.
